Confirm the frozen plan's intent and scope, then attest c1.

postconditions.statement: orchestrator context + glossary + relevant packet loaded; plan intent and scope confirmed

g1-build-destination.imperative: REASONING GATE (crew waived: the deliverable is doctrine prose whose tiering judgment is the Commander's own; a crew on a pure design note is shallower, not safer). full suite green

g4-disposition-lessons.title: Give all 20 active lessons a terminal disposition -- nothing stays active
g4-disposition-lessons.imperative: REASONING GATE (crew waived: 20 individual routing judgments over doctrine this Commander has read in full; a crew would re-read context this agent already holds). Every entry in LESSONS.md's Active section gets a TERMINAL disposition: graduate to docs/agents/ (naming the tier and why that audience) or to the doc that owns it, or delete with a stated reason. Nothing stays active. Retirement is the deletion path; a graduation is a paired edit-plus-retire whose retire reason names the destination. Write every op through apply_lessons_delta.py -- NEVER hand-edit LESSONS.md. Record the itemized disposition table in notes-308.md. Verify by READING BACK. CRITICAL CARVE-OUT (cold plan critic, BLOCKING 1): lesson:verify-launch-order-claims-against-code states cluster A's own pattern. Disposing it REQUIRES Tommy's bin ruling -- graduating it to docs/agents/ IS bin 2, so doing it here would be self-ruling, and if Tommy rules BIN 1 two consolidations would land, violating decision:one-consolidation-not-many. So this gate disposes the OTHER 19 and leaves exactly that one active, by id. g6 disposes it as part of the consolidation. If the ruling never arrives, that lesson stays active, Half 2 is honestly incomplete on one entry, and the branch is handed up PENDING saying so.

postconditions.statement: exactly ONE lesson remains active and it is the carved-out cluster-A lesson, asserted BY ID so no other entry can satisfy the count
all 20 dispositions itemized with destination-or-reason in notes-308.md
full suite green

constraints: NEVER hand-edit LESSONS.md; all writes via apply_lessons_delta.py.
Every graduation names its tier and justifies the audience (decision:tier-must-be-justified).
Verify by reading back, not by having written.

g5-cut-intake-implement.title: Cut live agents off from lessons
g5-cut-intake-implement.imperative: CREW GATE - dispatch constellation-implementer. Live agents stop reading lessons. The intake set was RE-ENUMERATED by command after the cold plan critic found the original hand-written list was under-inclusive (it named 5 sites; a grep over the corpus finds 6 across 5 files, and the original guard phrase matched only 2). Recording that because an under-inclusive enumeration presented as complete is literally issue-304-g3-001, one of the three episodes this issue consolidates. The complete set, by command: (1) skills/admiral/SKILL.md; (2) skills/admiral/templates/ADMIRAL_SPINE.template.json -- in the 'latitude' task, NOT 'context'; (3) skills/admiral/templates/LAUNCH_ORDER.template.md (inherited-context placeholder); (4) skills/charter/templates/AGENT_GUIDE.template.md; (5) skills/commander/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json -- TWO sites: the context imperative AND the context-manifest declaration entry. You MUST also update tests/test_context_manifest.py, whose DECLARATION pin (~line 550) lists ('durable', '.agent-work/LESSONS.md', False) as an exact literal -- dropping the manifest entry without it reds the suite. That edit is authorized by this gate. Do NOT touch the lessons-auditor skill or apply_lessons_delta.py: this is a cutover of the READ path, not a demolition of the writer. The launch-order block must still carry platform invariants and its charter-lite doctrine-carrier role -- remove the lessons half only. Every edited JSON template must still parse.

every touched JSON template still parses
